dataset: OS OpenMap Local FunctionalSite technical specification
evidence_slice: Ordnance Survey's official OS OpenMap Local FunctionalSite specification defines FunctionalSite as a polygon feature representing the area or extent of certain types of function or activity. It states that classification describes the actual function of a site, distinctiveName provides the site name when available, and geometry is a GM_MultiSurface representing the extent of the functional site. Those semantics provide site-level use evidence and polygon geometry, but not a physical building-footprint geometry or an individual Exeter building record.

field_evidence.footprint: Official specification defines FunctionalSite geometry as a GM_MultiSurface representing the extent of the functional site, not a physical building footprint.
field_evidence.type_use: classification describes actual site function and distinctiveName provides a site name when available; these are site-level semantics, not record-bound building footprint/type evidence.
field_evidence.source_scope: Official Ordnance Survey OS OpenMap Local feature-type documentation; public no-login source-area/schema metadata only, with no individual Exeter building feature in this window.
